_comment: Cards for tests/unit/effects/test_link_exiled.py. `t_lx_baron` is Timothar, Baron of Bats' dies trigger without its ward: exile the dead Vampire, create a Bat, grant the Bat a combat-damage trigger that returns 'the exiled card', and `link_exiled` the card to that Bat so the Bat's own `exiled_with: "self"` finds it. `t_lx_vampire` is a plain nontoken Vampire for it to watch.

cards.name: Test Linked Exile Baron
cards.oracle_text: Whenever another nontoken Vampire you control dies, you may pay {1} and exile it. If you do, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying. It gains "When this token deals combat damage to a player, sacrifice it and return the exiled card to the battlefield tapped."

abilities.text: Whenever another nontoken Vampire you control dies, you may pay {1} and exile it. If you do, create a 1/1 black Bat creature token with flying. It gains "When this token deals combat damage to a player, sacrifice it and return the exiled card to the battlefield tapped."
